title: Broken Lead Warner - Alternate Sound
description: Improves the lead break sound from the Broken Lead Warner mod by Superkat32
body:
This simple resource pack changes the broken lead warning sound added by Broken Lead Warner to use the vanilla Minecraft lead snap sound added in 1.21.6

Click [here](https://minecraft.wiki/images/Leash_Knot_Break.ogg) to preview the sound.

This pack requires the [Broken Lead Warner](https://modrinth.com/project/29RFArLV) mod. It should work with any Minecraft version supported by the mod.

Broken Lead Warner mod and original pack image by [Superkat32](https://modrinth.com/user/Y9qypgtn)
